description: Page through inbound email newest first, or tail new mail with since and wait. Filters by domain, status, date and sender, recipient or subject words; for body text, attachments or replies to a send, use searchEmails. Rows carry id, thread_id, received_at, from, to, subject, status and snippet; open one with getEmail. Result: emails, cursor for the next page (null at the end), and total, total_capped and total_unavailable when set.

api_key.description: API key from createEmailAddress, used in place of sign-in.

cursor.description: History cursor: the cursor of the page before. Returns emails OLDER than it, newest first. Not a date (use date_from or date_to); not with since.

date_from.description: Only rows whose created_at is at or after this date or time (UTC unless it has an offset).

date_to.description: Only rows whose created_at is at or before this; a bare date covers that whole day (UTC).

domain_id.description: One of your receiving domains, by the id getInboxStatus returns.

full.description: Return the stored record, with envelope addresses, message id and spam score, instead of the compact view for reading.

limit.description: How many emails this call returns; follow cursor for more.

search.description: Sender, recipient or subject words to match. To match message text, use searchEmails.

since.description: Tail cursor: start (from the first email), or the cursor of the page before. Returns emails NEWER than it, oldest first, to poll new mail without gaps. Not a date; not with cursor.

status.description: Processing stage: pending or accepted while in progress, completed when done, rejected if a filter or check refused it.

wait.description: Long-poll: how many seconds to hold the call open for new mail, so a since poll returns the moment mail arrives.

name: listEmails

outputSchema.description: A page of inbound emails, and the cursor for the next.

cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null at the end.

emails.description: The emails, newest first; oldest first when polling with since.

attachment_count.description: Attachments. Compact rows leave it out when 0.

automated.description: Sent by a machine. Compact rows set it only when true.

awaiting.description: Whose turn, when known: you (not yet answered) or them.

created_at.description: full only: when it was stored.

from.description: Sender, as the From header shows it.

id.description: Email id, for getEmail and getConversation.

reply_count.description: Replies you sent to it. Compact rows leave it out when 0.

snippet.description: Start of the body; null when there is none.

spam_score.description: full only: spam score; higher is spammier.

status.description: Processing stage: pending, accepted, completed or rejected.

thread_id.description: Conversation id; null when it is in none.

total.description: Matches, when counted; absent when the count was skipped or ran out of time.

total_capped.description: True when total stopped at its cap and is a lower bound.

total_unavailable.description: Set, true, when the count did not fit its time budget, so total is absent.

title: List inbound emails
